crossSystemMechanismEvidence.combinedHash: SHA-512 in matching four-participant crash architecture

simulation.interpretation: No measurable predictive signal from client-seed choice when the server preimage remains secret. This is consistent with SHA-512/random-oracle behavior and is not game-outcome/RTP execution evidence.

reason: The exact JOKERBET rules permit chosen client seeds but require an operator seed in the result and verification after the round. Public reference implementations of the same four-participant architecture expose only a one-way commitment pre-round. Six million synthetic SHA-512 outputs show no client-seed selection signal, as cryptographically expected.
